investigation_notes.Encoded Payload Detected: High-entropy, hex-like prefixes observed. Decoding attempts produced non-readable binary consistent with opaque identifiers or cache keys rather than readable/exfiltrated host data.
investigation_notes.Description: Anomalously large DNS responses (953 bytes vs typical 46 bytes) were observed for queries to contentdelivery.net, with sample subdomains containing hex-like prefixes and cache-oriented labels (httpcache, cacheod, dna). The root domain is long-established (created 2003) and the subdomain structure is consistent with CDN cache identifiers; decoding attempts yielded non-readable binary likely representing opaque IDs rather than sensitive host information. No recent host activity or similar alerts were identified, indicating a low likelihood of active data exfiltration and supporting a Low Priority triage.
